personType.label: Issuer type
personType.help: Facturae distinguishes a natural person (autónomo) from a legal entity.

firstName.label: First name
firstName.help: Individuals only: the legal name is split into first name and surnames.

verifactu.help: Every invoice you issue is recorded in a tamper-evident chain and reported to the Tax Agency (AEAT), and carries a QR code. Required for autónomos from 1 July 2027.

faceEmail.label: Email for FACe notifications
faceEmail.help: FACe tells you here when an invoice you send to a public administration is registered, rejected or paid. Needed to send invoices to FACe.

sealCertificate.label: My certificate is a company seal (certificado de sello)
sealCertificate.help: For Verifactu: tick it only if the certificate you upload is an electronic seal of a company, not a personal certificate.

taxType.label: Which tax is this?
taxType.help: Left empty it is IVA. Choose IGIC (Impuesto General Indirecto Canario) if you invoice from the Canary Islands. A withholding such as IRPF is not affected: it is the tax with a negative rate.

operation.label: Verifactu treatment of a 0% tax
operation.help: Only used when the rate is 0%: why no tax is charged. A tax above 0% is always taxed. The article of each exemption depends on the tax (E7 and E8 exist for IGIC only).
operation.S1: Taxed at 0% (a zero rate, e.g. IGIC tipo cero)
operation.S2: Taxable, reverse charge (inversión del sujeto pasivo)
operation.N2: Not subject: place-of-supply rules (e.g. services to a business in another country)
operation.N1: Not subject: article 7, 14 or other (IGIC: article 9)
operation.E2: Exempt: E2 (IVA article 21, exports; IGIC article 11)
operation.E4: Exempt: E4 (IVA articles 23 and 24; IGIC article 13)
operation.E7: Exempt: E7 (IGIC only: article 90 of the Canary Islands consolidated text)

isPublicAdministration.label: Public administration
isPublicAdministration.help: Invoices to public bodies go through FACe and need the three DIR3 codes below.

personType.label: Customer type
personType.help: Left empty it is worked out from the tax id.

firstSurname.help: Individuals only; the customer name is then the first name.

italy.partitaIvaInvalid: This is not a valid Partita IVA (eleven digits)
italy.lastNameRequired: An individual needs a last name
italy.fiscalCodeRequired: An individual needs their codice fiscale
italy.fiscalCodeInvalid: This is not a valid codice fiscale
italy.recipientCodeInvalid: A codice destinatario has 7 letters or digits
italy.postalCode: {subject}: an Italian CAP has five digits
italy.province: {subject}: the province is its two-letter code, e.g. MI

regime.label: Tax regime (regime fiscale)
regime.help: Printed on every FatturaPA. In the regime forfettario no IVA is charged and invoices above €77.47 carry the €2 marca da bollo.

personType.label: Issuer type
personType.help: An individual is named by first and last name in the FatturaPA, a company by its legal name.

fiscalCode.help: Required for an individual: the 16-character code. A company's is usually its Partita IVA (the Tax ID above).

recipientCode.help: The 7-character code your customer gave you. Leave it empty for a customer abroad, to send to their PEC, or for a consumer.

pec.help: The certified email for their e-invoices, if they have no codice destinatario.

fiscalCode.help: For a consumer in Italy without a Partita IVA.

kind.label: What is this tax? (Italy)
kind.help: Left empty it is IVA. A pension contribution charged to the customer (rivalsa INPS 4%, cassa professionale) is a contribution: tick "Part of the taxable amount" too, so IVA and the ritenuta include it. A ritenuta d'acconto is the tax with a negative rate.

fundType.label: Pension fund (tipo cassa)
fundType.help: For a contribution only. Left empty it is the rivalsa INPS (Gestione Separata).

withholdingType.label: Ritenuta type
withholdingType.help: For a withholding only. Left empty it is RT01, the ritenuta d'acconto of an individual.

paymentReason.label: Reason of the payment (causale)
paymentReason.help: For a withholding only, as in the Certificazione Unica. Left empty it is A, professional self-employment.

nature.label: Why no IVA is charged (natura)
nature.help: Required by the FatturaPA for IVA at 0%. Without an IVA tax at all, a forfettario invoice is N2.2.

natures.N2_1: N2.1 · Not subject: arts. 7 to 7-septies (e.g. services to a business abroad)
natures.N2_2: N2.2 · Not subject: other cases (regime forfettario, minimi)
natures.N3_3: N3.3 · Non-taxable: supplies to San Marino
natures.N5: N5 · Margin scheme / IVA not shown
natures.N6_2: N6.2 · Reverse charge: gold and silver
natures.N7: N7 · IVA paid in another EU country

germany.taxIdRequired: The Steuernummer or USt-IdNr is required on every invoice (§ 14 UStG)
germany.taxIdInvalid: This is neither a Steuernummer (10, 11 or 13 digits) nor a valid USt-IdNr
germany.vatIdInvalid: This is not a valid USt-IdNr (DE and nine digits)
germany.ibanInvalid: This is not a valid IBAN
germany.postalCode: {subject}: a German Postleitzahl has five digits

smallBusiness.label: Kleinunternehmer (§ 19 UStG): I charge no VAT
smallBusiness.help: Your invoices then carry the § 19 note and no VAT. Only possible below €25,000 of revenue last year and €100,000 this year.

vatId.help: DE and nine digits. Needed for customers in other EU countries; leave it empty if the Tax ID above already is it.

contactName.label: Contact name
contactName.help: For XRechnung: who the customer can ask about the invoice.

contactEmail.label: Contact email
contactEmail.help: For XRechnung: also the address the invoice comes from.

iban.help: Where the customer pays; XRechnung requires it for a bank transfer.

buyerReference.label: Leitweg-ID / buyer reference
buyerReference.help: A public administration gives you its Leitweg-ID; a business may give you a reference (a purchase order). Left empty, the invoice number is used.

email.label: E-invoice email
email.help: Where their XRechnung goes. Required for XRechnung.

category.label: Why no VAT is charged (Germany)
category.help: Required by XRechnung for VAT at 0%. For a Kleinunternehmer without any VAT tax, the § 19 note is used.
category.AE: AE · Reverse charge: the customer owes the VAT (§ 13b UStG, services to an EU business)
category.O: O · Not subject to German VAT (e.g. services to a business outside the EU)
category.E: E · Exempt (§ 4 UStG): give the reason below
category.Z: Z · Zero rate (§ 12 (3) UStG, e.g. solar panels)

exemptionNote.label: Reason on the invoice
exemptionNote.help: For an exemption, its legal basis (e.g. "Steuerfrei nach § 4 Nr. 21 UStG"). The other categories have a default text.

fatturapa.issuerInItaly: Issuer: the address must be in Italy
fatturapa.italianCustomerTaxId: Customer: an Italian customer needs a valid Partita IVA (the Tax ID) or codice fiscale
fatturapa.singleIva: An Italian invoice has one IVA rate per line: keep a single IVA tax for this customer
fatturapa.ivaRequired: The invoice needs its IVA; if none is charged, add an IVA tax at 0% with the reason (natura)
fatturapa.zeroIvaNature: IVA "{tax}" is 0%: choose why no IVA is charged (natura) on the tax
fatturapa.ivaBaseWithContribution: IVA "{tax}" must be calculated on the fee plus the contribution: tick "Part of the taxable amount" on the contribution and give it a lower order
fatturapa.ivaBase: IVA "{tax}" is calculated on something other than the invoice total before taxes
fatturapa.ivaAmount: IVA "{tax}": the amount does not match the rate
fatturapa.contributionBase: Contribution "{tax}" must be calculated on the invoice lines

xrechnung.issuerInGermany: Issuer: the address must be in Germany
xrechnung.contactName: Issuer: XRechnung needs a contact name
xrechnung.contactPhone: Issuer: XRechnung needs a contact phone
xrechnung.contactEmail: Issuer: XRechnung needs a contact email
xrechnung.ibanRequired: Issuer: XRechnung needs the IBAN the customer pays to
xrechnung.customerAddressRequired: Customer: the city and postal code are required
xrechnung.customerEmailRequired: Customer: XRechnung needs the email address their e-invoices go to (customer › E-invoice email)
xrechnung.noWithholding: XRechnung has no withholding: remove the negative tax from this customer
xrechnung.singleVat: One invoice has one VAT rate here: keep a single VAT tax for this customer
xrechnung.smallBusinessVat: A Kleinunternehmer charges no VAT: remove the VAT tax, or untick Kleinunternehmer
xrechnung.vatRequired: The invoice needs its VAT; if none is charged, add a VAT tax at 0% and choose why
xrechnung.zeroVatReason: VAT "{tax}" is 0%: choose why no VAT is charged on the tax
xrechnung.exemptReason: VAT "{tax}" is exempt: give the reason on the tax
xrechnung.reverseChargeBuyerVatId: Reverse charge: the customer's VAT identifier is required (the customer's Tax ID)
xrechnung.intraCommunityVatIds: An intra-community supply needs your USt-IdNr and the customer's VAT identifier
xrechnung.notSubjectTaxNumber: Not subject to VAT: XRechnung then needs your Steuernummer as the Tax ID, since the USt-IdNr cannot appear
xrechnung.vatBase: VAT "{tax}" is calculated on something other than the invoice lines
xrechnung.vatAmount: VAT "{tax}": the amount does not match the rate
xrechnung.totalsMismatch: The lines and VAT do not add up to the invoice total

verifactu.issuerNif: Your NIF in the Spanish settings must have nine characters
verifactu.invoiceNumber: The invoice number must be 1 to 60 printable ASCII characters

delivery.cancelledCannotBeSent: A cancelled invoice cannot be sent
delivery.notThroughChannel: Invoices to this customer do not go through {channel}

vatRegistered.label: VAT registered
vatRegistered.help: Your invoices are then VAT invoices: the Tax ID above is your VAT registration number (GB and nine digits).

tradingName.label: Trading name
tradingName.help: The name you trade under, if not your own (e.g. "Smith Consulting").

treatment.label: Why no VAT is charged (UK)
treatment.help: Required on a VAT invoice for VAT at 0%.
treatment.outside: Outside the scope of UK VAT (e.g. services to a business abroad)
treatment.reverseCharge: Domestic reverse charge (the customer pays the VAT to HMRC)

uk.vatNumberRequired: A VAT-registered business needs its VAT number as the Tax ID
uk.vatNumberInvalid: This is not a valid UK VAT number (GB and nine digits)
uk.taxIdInvalid: This is neither a UK VAT number nor a UTR (ten digits)
uk.postcodeInvalid: {subject}: this is not a UK postcode
uk.notRegisteredChargesVat: You are not VAT registered: remove the VAT from this customer's taxes, or tick VAT registered in Settings › Country & taxes.
uk.zeroVatNeedsTreatment: VAT "{tax}" is 0%: choose on the tax why no VAT is charged, as a VAT invoice must say it.
uk.customerAddressRequired: A VAT invoice shows the customer's name and address: complete the customer first.

common.notANumber: "{text}" is not a number: {what} is left out. Correct it in Settings.
common.selfCharged: Self-charged on services from abroad (reverse charge)

inpsRate.label: INPS contribution rate (%)
inpsRate.help: 26.07 for a professional in the Gestione Separata without another pension. Enter your fund's rate if you belong to a cassa professionale.

previousTax.label: Last year's tax (€, optional)
previousTax.help: From last year's Modello Redditi: the installments are then based on it (metodo storico). Left empty, they are based on this year's estimate (metodo previsionale).

previousContributions.label: Last year's INPS contributions (€, optional)
previousContributions.help: The INPS installments are then 40% and 40% of it; left empty, of this year's estimate.

coefficient.label: Profitability coefficient (by ATECO code)
coefficient.help: The share of your revenue that is taxed, set by the group of your ATECO activity code.
coefficient.c78: 78% · Professional, scientific, technical, health, education, finance
coefficient.c62: 62% · Street trade of other goods, trade intermediaries
coefficient.c54: 54% · Street trade of food and drinks

startup.label: New activity: 5% instead of 15% (first five years)
startup.help: For the first five years of an activity that is really new (art. 1, comma 65, L. 190/2014).

workDeduction.label: Apply the self-employment deduction (detrazione lavoro autonomo)
workDeduction.help: Art. 13 TUIR: up to €1,265, falling to nothing at €50,000 of income.

forfettario.help: Imposta sostitutiva and INPS: two installments (30 June, 30 November) and the balance the next June. No IVA.

ordinario.help: IVA every quarter; IRPEF and INPS in two installments (30 June, 30 November) and the balance the next June.

warnings.forfettarioCash: Revenue counts when invoiced; the regime forfettario counts it when collected (principio di cassa).
warnings.forfettarioImmediateExit: Revenue above €{limit}: the regime forfettario stops applying during the year, and IVA is due from the invoice that crosses it.
warnings.forfettarioLimit: Revenue above €{limit}: next year you leave the regime forfettario.
warnings.forfettarioExpenses: Expenses are not deducted in the regime forfettario: the coefficient stands for them.
warnings.ordinarioNotEstimated: Not estimated: the December IVA installment (acconto IVA) and the installment of the addizionale comunale.
warnings.inpsDeducted: INPS contributions are deducted in the year they are paid; the estimate deducts this year's own.

lines.taxCredit: Tax of the year (credit: more was withheld)

territory.label: Where you pay indirect tax
territory.help: The Canary Islands have IGIC, filed with Modelo 420; elsewhere it is IVA, filed with Modelo 303.

difficultExpenses.label: Deduct hard-to-justify expenses (gastos de difícil justificación)
difficultExpenses.help: 5% of the net income, at most €2,000 a year. Most autónomos and gestores apply it.

deductWithholdings.label: Subtract what customers withheld in Modelo 130
deductWithholdings.help: The law allows subtracting the IRPF your customers withheld (box 06). Untick it if your gestor leaves it out: you then get it back in the annual return.

warnings.chooseTerritory: Choose where you pay indirect tax (Canary Islands or elsewhere in Spain) to estimate IGIC or IVA.
warnings.otherTax: {count} invoice(s) charge a tax other than {tax}: it is not counted in {form}.

modelo130.name: Modelo 130 · IRPF prepayment
modelo130.difficult: of which hard-to-justify expenses (gastos de difícil justificación)
modelo130.withheldNotSubtracted: Withheld by customers (not subtracted: see settings)

smallBusiness.label: Kleinunternehmer (§ 19 UStG): no VAT returns
smallBusiness.help: Below €25,000 of revenue last year and €100,000 this year you may charge no VAT.

vatPeriod.label: VAT returns (Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung)
vatPeriod.help: Quarterly is the rule when last year's VAT was at most €9,000; monthly above.

extension.label: Dauerfristverlängerung: one month more for each return

insurance.label: Deductible insurance per year (€)
insurance.help: Health, care and pension contributions you deduct as Vorsorgeaufwendungen (only the deductible part).

prepayment.label: Einkommensteuer-Vorauszahlung per quarter (€)
prepayment.help: From your Vorauszahlungsbescheid, Soli and Kirchensteuer included. Left empty, each quarter is a quarter of this year's estimate.

tradeTaxPrepayment.label: Gewerbesteuer-Vorauszahlung per quarter (€)
tradeTaxPrepayment.help: From your municipality's Bescheid. Left empty, a quarter of this year's estimate.

freiberufler.name: Freiberufler (liberal profession)
freiberufler.help: Einkommensteuer, Soli and Kirchensteuer: four prepayments and the balance; VAT returns unless a Kleinunternehmer.

gewerbe.name: Gewerbetreibender (trade)
gewerbe.help: As a Freiberufler, plus the Gewerbesteuer (partly credited against the Einkommensteuer).

warnings.tariffYear: The Einkommensteuer of {year} is estimated with the tariff of {tariffYear}.
warnings.cashBasis: Revenue and expenses count when invoiced; the Einnahmenüberschussrechnung counts them when paid.
warnings.singleAssessment: Single assessment (Grundtarif): a joint assessment with a spouse (Splitting) is not estimated.
warnings.smallBusinessExceeded: Revenue above €{limit}: you are no longer a Kleinunternehmer, and VAT is due from the invoice that crossed it.
warnings.tradeTaxAdjustments: Gewerbesteuer additions and deductions (Hinzurechnungen, Kürzungen) are not estimated.
warnings.specialPrepayment: The Sondervorauszahlung that a monthly filer pays for the Dauerfristverlängerung is not estimated.
warnings.balanceDue: The balance is due about a month after the assessment (Bescheid); its date is the filing deadline of the returns.

lines.quarterOfEstimate: A quarter of this year's estimate

notSetUp.noProfile: Choose where you pay taxes in Settings to see an estimate.
notSetUp.otherCountry: Choose your tax regime in Settings › Country & taxes to see an estimate.

regime.name: Sole trader (Self Assessment)
regime.help: Income Tax, Class 4 National Insurance and student loans: two payments on account and a balancing payment. VAT returns every quarter, or the Flat Rate Scheme. The tax year runs from 6 April to 5 April.

vatScheme.label: VAT
vatScheme.help: You must register once your turnover passes £90,000 in 12 months.

stagger.label: VAT quarters
stagger.help: As on your VAT registration certificate.

flatRate.label: Flat rate (%)
flatRate.help: Your business type's rate; 16.5 for a limited cost trader.

firstYearDiscount.label: First year of VAT registration (1% off the flat rate)
firstYearDiscount.help: HMRC's discount for the first 12 months.

scottish.label: Scottish taxpayer
scottish.help: Scotland's Income Tax bands apply when you live in Scotland.

tradingAllowance.label: Use the £1,000 trading allowance when it beats your expenses
tradingAllowance.help: Instead of deducting your actual expenses: you can't do both.

previousYearTax.label: Last year's Self Assessment bill (£, optional)
previousYearTax.help: Income Tax and Class 4 National Insurance on last year's return: each payment on account is half of it. Left empty, this year's estimate is used.

lines.flatRateSurplus: + VAT kept under the Flat Rate Scheme
lines.vatReverseCharge: VAT due on services from abroad (reverse charge)

warnings.unknownYear: The rates of {year} are not known yet: those of {known} are used.
warnings.scottishBands: Scotland's bands for {year} are not included yet: those of {known} are used.
warnings.cashBasis: Income and expenses count when invoiced; since 2024/25 a sole trader's accounts use the cash basis (when paid) unless they opt out.
warnings.otherIncome: Only this business's profit is counted: employment, savings or dividend income would change the bands.
warnings.mustRegister: Turnover above £{threshold}: you must register for VAT.
